name: Motamota Valentine
original_name: モタモタバレンタイン
source:
Moka, the wolf girl and Tarika, the vampire are childhood friends.
Recently, they can't seem to do anything else than fight with each other.
One day, Moka decides to ask out a guy she likes and starts making some sweets to give him, but...
